articles.title: WordPress Backdoor Rebuilds Itself After Cleanup Using Files, Database, and Shared Memory
articles.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on a WordPress compromise in which threat actors deployed multiple persistence mechanisms to ensure that the final payload kept returning without having to infect the site again.   The backdoor has been codenamed SC  after the "SC_" markers present in the injected content. Sucuri has described the malware as a "self-healing mesh" that's blockchain-controlled.   "The payload lives in at least eight places at once, spread across files, the database, and shared memory, and every one of those places can rebuild all the others," security researcher Gabriel Barbosa said .   "Delete the plugin and a drop-in rewrites it. Delete the drop-in and the theme rewrites it. Clean every file on disk, and the next page load restores the whole set from the database or from a shared-memory segment. The result is a circular system with no single point you can remove to stop it."   According to Sucuri, the malware does no...
articles.title_fr: Une rétroporte WordPress se reconstruit après nettoyage en utilisant des fichiers, la base de données et la mémoire partagée
articles.summary_fr: Des chercheurs en cybersécurité ont mis en lumière un compromis WordPress où des acteurs malveillants ont déployé de multiples mécanismes de persistance. La rétroporte, surnommée SC, est un "maillage auto-réparateur" qui se reconstitue continuellement. Le code malveillant réside dans au moins huit emplacements (fichiers, base de données, mémoire partagée) et chaque emplacement peut reconstruire tous les autres.

articles.title: How Financial Services Companies Can Modernize Their Software Supply Chain
articles.summary: Every security leader at a bank, insurer, or asset manager has had a version of this conversation: Security wants to eliminate a class of vulnerabilities. Engineering explains what it would take to upgrade the platform where they live. Somebody prices out the regression testing. Somebody else raises the change-freeze calendar. The finding gets an exception, a compensating control, and a date eighteen months out on the roadmap to address it.   Nobody in that conversation is being unreasonable. Financial services carry more legacy software than almost any other industry for a few reasons: decades of accumulated infrastructure, regulatory obligations that reward stability, and applications where an hour of downtime is unacceptable. In that environment, minimizing change is  risk management. Every dependency bump, every base image swap, every migration is a chance to break something that clears trades or moves money.   So the instinct to stick to the status quo has been sound. The problem...
articles.title_fr: Comment les entreprises de services financiers peuvent moderniser leur chaîne d'approvisionnement logicielle
articles.summary_fr: Les entreprises de services financiers peinent à moderniser leurs logiciels en raison de systèmes hérités, d'obligations réglementaires et de la nécessité d'éviter toute interruption. Le maintien du statu quo est souvent privilégié, car chaque modification représente un risque pour des opérations critiques. Cela conduit à des vulnérabilités souvent reportées ou gérées par des exceptions plutôt que par des corrections immédiates.

articles.title: OpenAI Disrupts Reasoning Extraction Campaign Linked to Moonshot AI Associates
articles.summary: OpenAI on Wednesday said it identified and disrupted a coordinated distillation campaign that was designed to illicitly extract protected reasoning from its artificial intelligence (AI) models.   A "core cluster of the activity," going back to the first week of July, has been attributed to individuals associated with Moonshot AI, a Chinese AI company based in Beijing. It did not cite any technical evidence to back this assessment, likely owing to security reasons.   "The operators did not break our encryption, compromise a database, or gain direct access to stored user conversations," OpenAI said . "Instead, they manipulated model interactions so that protected reasoning could be reproduced in forms visible to the requester in a coordinated, scaled manner that violated our terms of service." articles.title_fr: OpenAI perturbe une campagne d'extraction de raisonnement liée à des associés de Moonshot AI
articles.summary_fr: OpenAI a identifié et perturbé une campagne coordonnée visant à extraire illégalement des raisonnements protégés de ses modèles d'IA. Cette activité, attribuée à des individus liés à la société chinoise Moonshot AI, impliquait la manipulation des interactions du modèle. Les opérateurs n'ont pas piraté les systèmes d'OpenAI, mais ont reproduit le raisonnement protégé de manière coordonnée et à grande échelle, violant ainsi les conditions de service.
